book.name: Mak
book.title: God ol wai ol na tongwo ha i Mak bol engwo dimia

content: Yisas gaung pol kungwo ha

Ena Yisas ha hon ainere yu ditongwi, “Yal tau malaya mongwohobi ta golkinamua. Homa God ari kene ongwo maing ire, nin yulang ire dire, u tibi nangwo hanere, emgi gonangwo pamua. Ha pangwo mere di ni teiya ogolo pirio,” dungwi.
Ena ari habang ana holo muru ana holo taniga a ba dire, Yisas ire, Pita ire, Yems ire, Yon ire dire, aule irere, hamen hul ta mini weni bani ongwi.
Pirere, yalhobi nin mongwi. Mongure, ena Yisas gaung hon pol kungure hangwi. Kungwo iwe, yal ta gal pege bigi si wai ole, enamba, kunu paikinama. Yu ongure hangwi.
Hangure, Ilaiya Moses kina ure Yisas kina si daule molere, ha diria ol mongure hangwi.
Ena Pita i hanere, Yisas yu ditongwi, “Tisao, nan yalhobi baniya mominga wai pamua. Pamia oo sui tai dire kenamina do. Kemingere ta ni oo dinangure, ta Ilaiya oo dinangure, ta Moses oo dinama do.”
Dungure, yal sui tai dire hobi kul bir pirere, mongure, Pita ha dungure grang obe abe yangwi.
Yu dungure, hamen kwahawa tau urere, yalhobi yobilungure, ha ta sina ali yu di mena olungwi, “Yal i na wana momia, na yona milna para teiwa. Ni yalhobi yal i ha dinangwo grang wine ole piro.”
Dungure gin tani weni yalhobi han holo holo olungure, ari ta monangwo hankima. Yisas tani mongwo, hangwi.

Ena hamen hul i aidolere, ere ya ime ungure, Yisas yalhobi hobang si tere yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi tal hanga iwe, ari ta ha wai ol tekio. Ari Wang Weni na iwe, golere, emgi hon airalga habang ari ditenanga pamua.”
Dungure yalhobi pirere, a i si mongwi. Molere yalhobi nin yu dungwi, “Yal i golere hon airalua dungwo i, tal maing pangwo dime?”
Direre hon sirin bol tongwi, “Talongure Yuda krehaman ha kene ongwo yalhobi Ilaiya homa u tibi namua dime?”

Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Owa, i ha weni kara dimua. Ilaiya homa u tibi pirere, talhan para muru akun ol enamia. Ha mining ganing ta yu pamiraya, “Yalhobi Ari Wang Weni ol gogo dal tenangwo gaung gul bir inangwo pamua.”
Talongure yu di eme? Ilaiya haya umia, ari hobi nin nomani si pungwo meri yali yu ol tomia, ha mining ganing homa di engwo irai giu dire pamia. Na omaga di ni teiya piro.” dungwi.
Yisas gir ta kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongure si doleng i olungwo ha

Ena Yisas yasu hobi kina u bangi urere, u grang wine ongwo tau mongwo bani pa direre, ari tabin bir weni u ku bongure, hangwi. Ena Yuda krehaman ha kene ongwo yal tau Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi kina ha bolbin diriyala ol mongwi. Mongure, ari tabin bir hobi Yisas u pa dungwo hangwi.
Hanere, ganulun bir dire, bli si pirere, kewaa ditongwi.
Ditongure, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi kina tal ha bolbin dine?”
Yu dungure ari mongwo sina i yal ta aire, yu ditongwi, “Tisao. Na wana kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongure, ha dikimia, aule ire ni monga bani wiwa.

Hamen haung haung kwia i gir yong sina molere, nona pare, honagi ol tongure, gir i habilai simua.Habilai sire grang niri baregi dungure, siging girimil nure, aling kebering para si to sire dimua. Na ni gran wine ongwo hobi awai ol tenama dire diiba, yalhobi ongwo kunu paikimua.”
Ditongure, Yisas ha i pirere yu ditongwi, “Ha diga wine olere, a i si wakingiwe, na molkiralga tal onane? Mol i pire emgi talongwo na hon a ki di ni terale? Gir i aule ire na molga baniya wo.”
Dungure, ari hobi gir aule ire Yisas mongwo bani ongwi. Ongure, kwia nigi dongwo Yisas gumang hanere, gir i ere han ire pegare ol tongwi. Ol tongure, yare, habilai sire, grang niri u hole mongwi.
Mongure, Yisas gir irang yu sirin bol pungwi, “Gir i omaga om mo, haya ome?”

Dungure irang yu ditongwi, “Hamen haya gir migi mongwo ali ya ol mongwo bani momua. Hamen haung haung kwia nigi dongwo i ol tongure, u dia enda ali sirere, u dia nir ali pirere, si golala dire omua. Ni milna pirere aki di na terala dipinanga, aki di na tenanba?”
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “Oa, na awai ol ni teralga pamia di pinga meri ol ni teralua.”
Ditongure irang erakere ditongwi, “Ni onanga kunu benama di piminba, nomani susu sire a i si wanaminga paikimia, ni aki di na to.”

Dungure Yisas hangure, ari para weni u yobilungwi. Yobilungure, kwia nigi dongwo kura ha ditongwi, “Ni kwia nigi denga ari yong sina ali monga, kraung gi dire, ha mining paikimia, aidole, ere mena wo.

Urere, hon siina dire, ari yong sina hoyo.” Dungure, kwia nigi dongwo i, gala bir weni dire, ere han ire gir i ol terere, ere mena ungwi. Yu ongure, gir i kara gol howa di ongwi. Omia arihobi hanere, “Gir i kara gomua,” dungwi.
Dire han mongure, Yisas ure, aling aki dungure, airungwi.
Ena emgi ere ala ongure, grang wine ongwo hobi nin mole, yu sirin bol pungwi, “Na yalhobi kwia nigi dongwo si doling i oliminga paikimia, tal onamne?”
Dungure, Yisas yu ditongwi, “God aki di na to dinanga kwia nigi dongwo si doling i olanga pamia. Tal ta onanga, kunu paikinamua,” dungwi.
Yisas gole airalua gin su dungwo ha
Ena yu ditere, aidolere, ere Galili ganba sina ongwi. Pire Yisas kul si molere, grang wine ongwo hobi ha nir si terala di pungwi.

Pirere, yu ditongwi, “Ari Wang Weni, na iwe, ari na i kura bolimbani olamua. Yu olere na si gonangwo pamua. Golere ari habang sui tai di pai molere, God aki di na tere ulna yunangure hon airalga pamua.”
Yu dungure yalhobi pir pa dikimia, sirin bol tenamba, kul pungwi.
God kene ongwo bani yal ara singaba moname? dire gamahobi sirin bongwo ha
Ena yalhobi hon pi Kapaneam pa dungwi. Pa dire pi ala molere, Yisas grang wine ongwo hobi yu sirin bol tongwi, “Ni yalhobi hol bangi tal ha bolbin dine?”
Yu dimba, yalhobi pir uning si mongwi. Momia, hol bangi iwe, urere “Nan yal ara singaba molere, kene onamne?” dire bolbin dungwi.

Dungure Yisas ami di molere, grang wine ongwo ari ana holo holo kebena sutani yalhobi gala dire, ere wio, dungwi. Direre, yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi singaba molala di pinanga iwe, ya ime sire, nir honagi ol tere, mol i nanga, singaba monanga pamua.”
Yu dire gir migi ta i sina erere, kulere, yu ditongwi,

“Ni yalhobi yal ta, na hana pirere, gir migi mongwo i pana gal tenanga iwe, na pana gal na tenanua. Te na pana gal na tenanga iwe, na tani taman. Nabe hamen ya singaba pana gal tenanua. Nabe na bai nu sungure na ya ime wiwa” dungwi.
Yal ta kiang pai na tekinangwo yali nan gamna hobo monangwo ha
Ena Yon Yisas sirin bol tere yu dungwi, “Tisao, yal ta ni hani a i wa molere, kwia nigi dongwo si doling i olungwo haminia. Hanere, na gamnahobo ta molkinia yu olkio dire, mana ditominua.”
Dungure Yisas yu ditongwi, “A, i mana ditekio. Te yal ta na hana a i wa molere, tal guma hon i tibi olamia, emgi na gauna ha si na tenam mo?
Ta si na tekinama. Te yal ta kiang pai na tekinangwo iwe, nan yol e nominga monamua.

Ena yal ta ni yalhobi ni hanere, yu nomani si pinamia, O, na singaba Kraist grang wine ongwo hobi aki di teralua, di pire mulu hau nir holere ni tenangwo nenanua. Yu ol ni tenangwo yal iwe, emgi God siina dire tobo tenangwo pamua. Na ha weni kara di ni teiwa,” dungwi.
Ari pir tongwo hobi tal nigi dongwo isusu ol tenangwo ha

Ena Yisas hon ainere yu ditongwi, “Ena gir migi ta na tal ol tega ha maing a i warere, na pir na tenangwo, yal ta hanere, a, i hasu onua, ditenangwo, gir i pirere, na mobing hal wa na tenamia. Ditenangwo yal iwe, kwahulu bir weni ta nugung bani han hol erere, u di nir digan man ali pirere, gonangwo oun denamo?

I ta dekinamia. Na tal ol teralga iwe, tal oun dongwo ol teralua. Te ani weni hol iwe, tal nigi dongwo olere, pring au si ni terala di onangure, di keuru si olo. Yu ongere ani taniga dinangure, moli pire hamen bani nanga pamua. Te ani sutani dinangure, endo de pangwo bani nanga pamia.
Pirere, gin tani ta golkinanua. Te endo i wai ta sikinamua.

Te kebin weni hol i, tal nigi dongwo olere, pring au si ni terala di onangure, di keuru si olo. Yu ongere, kebin taniga dinangure, hamen bani nanga pamua. Te kebin sutani ereho ya dinangwo moli pirere, endo de pangwo bani nanga pamia.
Pirere, gin tani ta golkinanua. Te endo i wai ta sikinamua.

Te omin weni hol i, tal nigi dongwo ol warere, pring au si ni terala di onangure, si gi di olo. Yu ongere, omin taniga dinangure, hamen bani nanga pamua. Te omin su dinangure, endo de pangwo bani nania.
Pirere gin tani ta golkinania. Te endo i wai ta sikinamua. ( Ais 66:24)
“Homena pil onga bengwo mere iwe, endo giini bli bali dire ari para muru denamua.”

“Ena pil i tal wai dimia. Dimba, gwiring mena pi wai sinangure, irere, tal onamne? Tal ta omingere, gwiring hon monamo? Ta molkinama. Ni yalhobi homena pil ongwo mere iwe, kunu ganba sinaya monia. Molere, yon milni ura dinangure, ya ime sire, ari hobi kina yon tani erere, mol i nanua,” dungwi.
